subsystem.name: UIPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: UI control widgets and their rendering, text handling, layout computation, event dispatch, options-screen (.OSC) configuration parsing, and UI message dispatch. All facts are DERIVED from the validated function IR; class and field identity at equal offsets across different 'this' pointers is not proven common ownership.

summary: This subsystem reconstructs a UI control platform and options layer. A central UIWidget object (GUESS) owns a string buffer (+0x40), a path string (+0xB8), a text/font resource object pointer (+0xC8), a list head/count (+0x90/+0x94), a render-node pool (+0xEC..+0xF8), dimension arrays (+0x110..+0x14C), layout/count fields (+0x14C..+0x174) and a window-control type (+0x30C). Render dispatch (0x00488F40, 0x00489FD0, 0x0048B030), list selection (0x00489AB0), dimension capture (0x0048EBD0), text-window setup (0x0048F9F0), path-based window classification (0x0048C0E0, 0x004901A0) and click-event forwarding (0x004957A0) all operate on that object. A text input handler (0x004896C0) word-wraps input into per-line menu items, an event shortcut handler (0x0048B600) implements a text-edit field keyboard state, a viewport layout calculator (0x0048F640) computes a tile grid, a renderer (0x0048FEE0) draws a text region in one of three modes, two constructors initialize UI objects (0x0048FC50, 0x0048FD60, 0x0048FE60), an options reader (0x00492160) parses .OSC configuration files, and three helpers dispatch UI messages (0x00494F10), clean up a global UI iterator (0x004950C0), and render a multi-option text dialog (0x00495BD0). A recurring default-string global byte_5EA438 substitutes for null strings throughout.

function_roles.role: UI render dispatch wrapper: copies a resolved child string (*(this+0xC8)+0x40, default byte_5EA438) into the widget string buffer at this+0x40, then delegates rendering to UILargeRenderDispatcher with the caller's arguments.

Word-wraps input text to the available widget width, creating one UI menu item per wrapped line and optionally naming each item; measures text with TextRenderToSurface and finalizes via sub_489D00 and a vtable+44 completion dispatch. Returns -1 on null input.

Validates a 1-based selection against the item count at this+0x94, stores the 0-based selection at this+0x168 (or -1 on invalid input), optionally scrolls the list, then walks the list from this+0x90 and passes four node strings to a vtable display method (obj+0xA8).

Dispatches custom UI render nodes: walks the list from this+0x90, resolves each node name through DriverNameStringHandler/StringArrayMatchSearch against a name array with byte_5EA438 fallback, computes per-node render geometry, dispatches node render through the node vtable slot 52, and accumulates viewport bounds into the caller out-parameters. Returns -1 when row/column counts are invalid.

Full UI text render pass with word-wrap: measures the horizontal boundary span, clears the render-node pool (this+0xEC..+0xF8), tokenizes the input text, builds a linked list of one render node per wrapped token, and computes per-line height into this+0x108. No-op on null input.

Keyboard/event handler for a text edit field: gated by a master enable byte, walks event codes (backspace on 14, accept on 1/28), translates/filters characters, inserts at the cursor with a width/overflow re-check, refreshes rendered text, and activates the value via vtable dispatch.

Determines a window control type (0, 1 or 2) stored at this+0x30C by sequentially comparing the path string at this+0xB8 (default byte_5EA438) against three reference strings via sub_588410; last write wins.

Captures eight dimension values from child widgets via sub_487060 into this+0x110..+0x12C and eight via sub_4870E0 into this+0x130..+0x14C, applies fallback defaults for four negative dimensions, issues a virtual layout call (vtable slot 16 with this+0x104), resolves three delegated dimensions into this+0xE4..+0xEC, calls UIWindowTextSetup, and clears this+0x168.

Computes a tile-grid layout for a viewport: reads viewport bounds, walks the child list seeded at this+0xF0 accumulating max tile width/height, computes columns/rows and a total/scroll value from layout mode this+0x100 (0 vertical, 1 horizontal), and on overflow resets this+0x104 via a vtable+0x40 virtual call. Always calls UITileGrid and returns the result of a vtable+0x2C call with argument 1.

Configures a UI text-window object: copies the directory path (this+0xB8, default byte_5EA438), searches token word_5C32D8, loads two resource objects into this+0x154 and this+0x150, and classifies the layout mode written to this+0xE0 (0/1/2) by token comparison.
UI control object constructor: calls the base struct initializer UIStructInit_e9e0, zeroes +0x30 and +0x38, stores a -1 sentinel at +0x34, and installs the vtable off_5A4450 at +0x0.
UI structure constructor: delegates to the base initializer UIStructInit_e9e0, installs the vtable off_5AC69C at +0x0, and zero-initializes the field at +0x30. Returns the this pointer.
UI component initializer: calls base initializer ShortComputation_5e30, installs the vtable off_5AC6B0, and sets state fields this+0xE0 = 1 and this+0xE4 = 0.

Full UI render helper: resolves the render string (this+0xB0, default byte_5EA438), measures it, reads two dimension pairs, clamps the four in-out viewport pointers, and selects one of three draw paths by render-mode flag this+0xE4 (0 full, 1 top, 2 bottom). Returns 0 on every exit.

Classifies a UI window by copying its name/path (this+0xB8, default byte_5EA438) into a local 63-byte buffer and comparing it against three tokens, storing a numeric window type 0/1/2 in this+0xE4; returns the outcome of the final comparison.

Parses an options screen configuration (.OSC) file line by line; guarded by the options object pointer at this+0x1A4 (null logs the self-identifying invalid-options error and returns 0). Optionally builds the options screens path, then dispatches each token to handlers for Attributeset, Layer, Gizmo, Dopage, Loadingscreenp, Systemfont, Tooltipfont, tooltip colors, SetSymbol and DisableGizmo.

Dispatches a UI message via sub_53D2E0; when the a6 flag is set, first looks up the message in the binary string table byte_5EC4C0 via BinarySearchInStringTable, copies it into buffer byte_5EC4CC, and dispatches the buffered string instead.

Conditional one-shot UI iterator cleanup: when the global iterator handle dword_7CDE10 is non-zero, passes it to UICleanupIterator and returns that result; otherwise returns the zero handle unchanged.

UI click-event dispatch: iterates WORD event codes; event 1 resolves a handler string through this+0x18 -> this+0x68 -> +0x60, event 28 through the same chain to +0x58; a null handler string falls back to byte_5EA438, then sub_4988D0 dispatches the resolved string and the event is forwarded through vtable slot 8.

Renders a multi-option text dialog: a measure pass and a render pass over four 12-byte entry slots starting at byte offset 5628 of this, drawing a background/shadow for the first entry, dispatching a UI message per entry, and blitting the composed region to the render surface. Returns the active-entry count.

classes.name: UIWidget
classes.responsibility: Core UI control object owning the string/path resources, the text/font resource child object, a linked list of named render/list nodes, a render-node pool, dimension and layout fields, and the click-event handler chain. Render dispatch, list selection, dimension capture, text-window setup and window classification all operate on this object. Grouping is GUESS: equal offsets on unrelated 'this' pointers are not proof of common ownership.

classes.name: UITextInputHandler
classes.responsibility: Text-input widget specialization that word-wraps incoming text into one UI menu item per line. Shares the widget layout field region (this+0x0C, +0x94, +0xC8, +0x140) with UIWidget at GUESS level.

classes.name: UIEventShortcutHandler
classes.responsibility: Keyboard/event handler for a text edit field: maintains an edit buffer/cursor state, translates and filters key events, and activates the value via vtable dispatch. Field identities in the +0x2F0..+0x2FC range are DERIVED for this object.

classes.name: UIViewportLayoutCalculator
classes.responsibility: Computes a tile-grid layout (columns, rows, total/scroll) from the maximum child dimensions and the viewport bounds. Layout mode this+0x100 selects vertical (0) or horizontal (1). On viewport overflow it resets state through a vtable slot and invokes UITileGrid.

classes.name: UIRenderer
classes.responsibility: Text region renderer that measures a render string, clamps in-out viewport pointers, and draws the region in one of three modes selected by this+0xE4 (0 full, 1 top, 2 bottom). Owner identity is GUESS.

classes.name: Options_OSC_Reader
classes.responsibility: Line-oriented parser for options screen (.OSC) configuration files. Guarded by the options object pointer at this+0x1A4; dispatches recognized tokens (Attributeset, Layer, Gizmo, Dopage, Loadingscreenp, Systemfont, Tooltipfont, tooltip colors, SetSymbol, DisableGizmo) to dedicated handlers. The tooltip font buffer and tooltip color offsets inside the options object (+5432, +180, +184) are described in prose only and have no allowed field evidence in this packet.

classes.name: UIMessageDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Global UI message dispatch helper. With the a6 lookup flag set it performs a binary search of the message against the global binary string table byte_5EC4C0 and dispatches the buffered result from byte_5EC4CC. Operates on globals, not on a 'this' object.

classes.name: UIIteratorLifecycle
classes.responsibility: Conditional one-shot cleanup of the global UI iterator handle dword_7CDE10 through UICleanupIterator. Owner class identity is GUESS; the function may be a free helper rather than a method.

classes.name: UITextDialog
classes.responsibility: Multi-option text dialog renderer: two passes (measure and render) over four 12-byte entry slots starting at byte offset 5628 of this, per-entry UI message dispatch, and a final blit of the composed region. The entry-slot region has no allowed field evidence in this packet.

classes.name: UIObject
classes.responsibility: Base UI object construction. Two constructors share the base initializer UIStructInit_e9e0 and a zeroed +0x30 field but install distinct vtables (off_5A4450 vs off_5AC69C), so they likely construct different derived UI object types; the shared-class relationship is GUESS.

classes.name: UIComponent
classes.responsibility: UI component initializer using the base routine ShortComputation_5e30 and vtable off_5AC6B0; sets the +0xE0 and +0xE4 state fields. These equal offsets on a different base than UIWidget/UIEventShortcutHandler are not proven common fields.

transitions.trigger: mode flag this+0xE4 outside 0..2 or empty render string: return 0, no draw
accumulated token width exceeds lineWidthPx; append render node, reset token cursor
byte equals 0x0A; append render node, reset token cursor
charPosition reaches final index; replay unconsumed chars and append final render node

event code 1 or 28: refresh rendered text and dispatch vtable slot 0xB0

interfaces.name: ITextRenderSurface
interfaces.purpose: Text measurement and boundary queries used by render passes: TextRenderToSurface measures width/height, and sub_487060/sub_4870E0 return indexed widget dimensions.

interfaces.name: IUIRenderDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Widget-level render entry points that resolve strings/resources and dispatch to bitmap draw helpers; consumed via UIFullRenderWithDimensions and the render-node pass.

interfaces.name: IUIMessageDispatch
interfaces.purpose: UI message dispatch with optional string-table lookup/translation, used by the text dialog renderer and other UI code.

interfaces.name: IOSCOptionsScreenSource
interfaces.purpose: Token dispatch contract for .OSC options screen files; each recognized token routes to a dedicated handler or virtual method.

interfaces.name: IVirtualWidgetSlots
interfaces.purpose: Virtual dispatch contract observed through the vtable pointer at this+0x0: container query (slot 24), event forward (slot 8), update (slot 44/0x2C), display (slot 168/0xA8), enter activation (0xB0) and layout/reset (0x2C/0x40). Slot meanings are reconstructed per call site.

compatibility_contracts.name: DefaultStringFallback
compatibility_contracts.description: A null string pointer at many widget fields (this+0x40, +0xB0, +0xB8, child +0x40/+0x48, list node +0xA0, edit lookup source) is substituted with the global default string byte_5EA438 before copy/render/dispatch. A replacement executable must reproduce this null-to-default substitution in the same paths or dependent layout/rendering changes.

compatibility_contracts.name: EventCodeSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: UI event codes are WORD codes with fixed meanings at these call sites: 14 = backspace, 1 and 28 = accept/enter, all others = character input. Handlers dispatch handler strings (event 1 -> handler+0x60, event 28 -> handler+0x58) and forward through vtable slots. A replacement must keep these event-code meanings for the text edit and click dispatch paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: WindowTypeClassification
compatibility_contracts.description: Window and window-control types 0/1/2 are selected by comparing the widget path (this+0xB8) against three reference strings (byte_5CC21C, aC_0, aR) with sub_588410; comparisons run sequentially and the last match wins. Results are stored at this+0x30C (control) and this+0xE4 (window). A replacement must preserve the three-way classification and its storage offsets for matching layout behavior.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextRegionRenderModes
compatibility_contracts.description: The render-mode flag at this+0xE4 selects the drawn text region: 0 draws the full measured region (BitmapDraw_81f0), 1 draws the top, 2 draws the bottom, and any other value returns 0 without drawing. Viewport pointers a2/a3/a4/a5 are clamped with mode-dependent min/max. A replacement must reproduce the three modes and the empty-string early return.

compatibility_contracts.name: OSCConfigTokenFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: The options screen reader parses lines and dispatches the tokens Attributeset, Layer, Gizmo, Dopage, Loadingscreenp, Systemfont, Tooltipfont, tooltip colors (aTooltipColorFi/aTooltipColorEd), SetSymbol and DisableGizmo to specific handlers. A replacement must recognize this token set for .OSC files to load options screens equivalently.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringTableMessageLookup
compatibility_contracts.description: UIMessageDispatch with the a6 flag set performs a binary search of the message in the binary string table byte_5EC4C0 via BinarySearchInStringTable, remaps the message through the byte_5EC4CC buffer, and dispatches the buffered string. A replacement must preserve the lookup-on-flag behavior so message identity survives the translation path.
